spec_match.rationale: A real CPU-loaded AudioWorkletProcessor with switchable renderSizeHint and honest 'ACTUAL QUANTUM (unknown)' readout where the property is absent.

interactive.rationale: Hint buttons, load slider, and start/stop are all wired to the live audio graph.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised crank-until-it-breaks stress design.

edge_cases.rationale: Honest unknown-quantum readout, but a context that never starts (no activation/audio output) leaves all counters at 0 with no explanation.

references.rationale: Has an external spec reference but omits the chromestatus.com/feature/5078190552907776 self-heal link.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 2 pass / 5 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: Start left PROCESS() CALLS/S, GOOD BLOCKS, and MISSED DEADLINES at 0 for 3 seconds with no running/suspended indicator — honest zeros, but the silent-not-running state is indistinguishable from a working-but-idle worklet; zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables; three raw hex values sit in the scope canvas palette.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons and slider carry labels (6 hits) but the health meters and scope are visual-only.

openQuestions.title: Surface the AudioContext state next to the meters
openQuestions.detail: When the context stays suspended (synthetic click, autoplay-blocked, no output device) every meter reads 0 with no explanation; render ctx.state and a 'waiting for audio to start — click Start again' note so the stall is honest. Real user clicks carry activation, so this is robustness, not a broken path.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: cycled quantum hints and clicked Start; meters stayed honestly at 0 ('ACTUAL QUANTUM (unknown)') but no context-state feedback explains the non-start under a synthetic activation-less click; zero console errors.
